styleOptions.title: 2D Animation
styleOptions.desc: Bright, light, and dynamic style. Great for social media, explainer videos, and creative ads.

styleOptions.title: 3D Animation

styleOptions.title: Live-Action + Animation

aspectOptions.title: 1:1 — Square
